messages:
incident-bot: ALERT triggered: latency.p99.chat_completions.global > 1.5s for 5m. Pager escalated to #eng-oncall.
Carla M: saw the pager. p99 is spiking on the chat completions route for a subset of models (mix: oasst-3 & redwood-v1) — throughput is fine but tails are bad.
Mike H: adding context — KV cache eviction rate jumped on the serving nodes in us-west-2 around the same time. Not sure if causation yet.
Sasha R: @Carla M can you surface which routes are firing? per-route alert is noisy today.
Carla M: sure. From the alert -> route tags: `/chat/completions` (default), `/chat/completions?variant=oasst-3-medium`, `/chat/completions?variant=redwood-v1-large`. Most hits on the oasst variant.
oncall-backup: repro attempt: hit the failing route with 10 concurrent sessions, p95 ~ 450ms, p99 ~ 1.8s locally against dedicated pool; p99 tails correlate with cold KV lookups.
Priya (ProdOps): customer impact: two enterprise customers reported degraded response times for their chat widgets. No downtime, but UX latency > 2s for some flows. CS has been looped.
Carla M: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) Temporary adjust alert quiesce to p99 > 2.2s for 15m for `/chat/completions?variant=oasst-3-medium` only; 2) Route-weight shift to smaller model variant for tiered customers; 3) Enable kvcache warmup on recent shards. Thoughts?
Mike H: +1 on temporary squelch for that specific route. We should NOT change global p99. I can open a short-lived reroute to `oasst-3-fast` with partial fallback (only for non-SLA customers).
Sasha R: prefer to do a targeted squelch instead of lowering p99 thresholds across the board — reduces pager noise while on-call investigates. Can someone update the dashboard to show per-model p99 heatmap?
Carla M: on it. Creating a quick grafana panel: p95/p99 by route+model, 1m/5m buckets. Will post link.
oncall-backup: mitigation executed: created routing rule `fallback=o:oasst-3-fast` for 10% of traffic from non-SLA orgs. Observing immediate p99 drop from 1.8s -> 1.1s on sampled traffic.
incident-bot: Routing change deployed by Mike H at 2154321124.
Priya (ProdOps): notified impacted customers with timeline and mitigations. Asking if we can offer reduced-cost credits for affected windows.
Mike H: exploring root cause: KV cache thrash due to a regression in our eviction heuristics deployed yesterday (eng-runtime). Rolling back the eviction change on a subset of nodes for test.
Sasha R: while rollback runs, let's set a temporary policy: squelch alert for `/chat/completions?variant=oasst-3-medium` p99 until 2154322024 (15m window) and create a noise-gate on the alert to require p99>1.9s for 3 consecutive 1m buckets.
Carla M: wrote the noise-gate rule in the alert config: `condition: p99 > 1.9s for 3m` and scope: `route==/chat/completions and model =~ /oasst-3/`. Pushed to staging alertmanager then to prod.
incident-bot: Alert config change submitted by Carla M at 2154321160.
Mike H: rollback looks promising on the sample nodes: eviction rate back to baseline and p99 on those nodes ~1.05s. Rolling out rollback to remainder of serving group over next 6 minutes.
oncall-backup: after partial rollback + routing, overall p99 for the route is down to 1.2s; users reporting improved latencies.
Priya (ProdOps): CS update: customers A and B confirmed their widgets improved. We'll keep them updated during the rollback.
Sasha R: followups/action items before we close the thread: 1) revert squelch and re-evaluate alert thresholds tomorrow with a per-model SLI baseline; 2) add per-model p99 panel to the standard oncall dashboard; 3) run an offline sweep of eviction heuristics and add a canary test; 4) draft post-incident note for Ops. Anyone add to that?
Carla M: adding: 5) add a temporary runbook snippet for model-variant routing fallback (steps + safety checks) and 6) add a config to automatically mute alerts for synthetic traffic bursts during model rollouts.
Mike H: will own the rollback verification and coord with eng-runtime to revert the eviction change permanently if tests pass.
Priya (ProdOps): I'll own customer comms + credits decisioning.
Sasha R: ok looks stable. I'll mark this thread as handoff to post-incident and create a follow-up doc in #eng-platform for threshold tuning workshop next week. :white_check_mark: 
Carla M: thanks all — leaving notes in the incident tracker with links to the dashboard and routing change.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: latency.p99.chat_completions.global reduced below alert threshold at 2154321278. Pager quieted.
